text:
absolute perfection
the layout is so convenient and clear and satisfying. the way everything works is just perfect. i love music so obviously spotify is one of my favorite apps. making playlists is so easy and fun, looking at ur listening stats is also really interesting and cool, u can also see when ur fav artists are touring near u and stuff like that. u can do a lot of things and its just so easy to use and useful as well as enjoyable. i love the aesthetic as well. i dont have premium but i probably will get it soon. to be honest, i dont really need premium. in my opinion the only downsides of not having premium is that u get frequent ads and also u cant download songs/playlists. i dont think the other elements of premium are actually worthwhile but anyways. I LOVE SPOTIFY SO MUCH AND I HIGHLY RECOMMEND DOWNLOADING IT!!!! 🎶⭐️🎸🎧
